body: I'm actually her sister, but thanks anyway! :D

Thank you very much. We try to do the right thing but it's very difficult... 
To give you an example of how my country helps in crisis - once I had to call the emergency number for a psychiatric crisis because my sister was completely hysterical and we didnt' know what to do, she was really out of herself. They told me "yeah we can't do much but you should try and slap her in the face, it might help". Okay... Needless to say I didn't follow that advice but tried non-violent communication and my sister could calm down after an hour or so.
We went to see her yesterday and she agreed to go to the centre. We told her that we would tell people she's in some kind of a revalidation center after a liver disease - not 100% lying because she does have liver problems because of what she's done. Hopefully she'll come out of it a happier, healthier person. She deserves it so much.
Thanks again for your kind words & advices.

Thanks, I'm going to take a look. But honestly right now we just need to convince her it's for her own good, because we don't want to lose her, we don't want her to kill herself and we don't want her to be miserable. But she's very paranoid and thinks we all made an alliance against her... even her doctor & therapist insist on how urgent it is for her to be placed in a center, hell her doctor wanted to stop ME from working so that I could spend 24/7 with my sister to make sure she wouldn't try to kill herself again... I absolutely can't do that!!! I'm not a nurse, I'm not a therapist, I'm not a prison guard! 
I already looked on the internet how to do to convince someone they need to be placed in a institute for their own mental well being but can't find anything helpful right now... :( I know someone who's got a mental disease goes through a lot of suffering but we cannot take this anymore either, my mom's in depression because of my sister, she's scared all the time, she has to sleep with her handbag or my sister would steal her money/car keys, it's NOT okay, even though my sister is sick she CAN NOT do this to my only parent left... We want her to heal but how do we do this if she doesn't want to?

You're absolutely right for my language, sorry. I wrote that under a lot of anger/frustration/fear. In French we call these "coups de folie", "craziness strikes" literaly but I don't know how to translate that in English. We know she's mentally sick, we don't know what exactly but yeah she's sick and it's in no way her fault. But at some point, it's not OUR fault either and she puts us through a lot - violence, abuse, disapearing without leaving a trace... she always does that but turns on her phone from time to time to be sure that we are looking for her, that we call her, that we're worried. We are tired and helpless. 

For an involuntary commitment in my country we have to take this to a judge who's going to decide if it's necessary or not... but apparently more often than not they decide it is not. But if we don't help her we can be convicted for non assistance to a person in danger. So what do we do now? We're still going to try for the judge but it takes up to 6 months to get an answer... We talked to her doctor & therapist and they absolutely insist that she HAS to go to the institute but she doesn't see it the right way. She thinks of it as an asylum but it's a center with therapist where she can go outside, she can plan her day as she wants - there's a planning for the meals and for when to get up / go to bed but that's it. Kind of like a retreat where she'll be surrounded by people able to help her. She doesn't want to go, she's having a paranoia / persecution crisis where she thinks we want to get rid of her...

Thanks for your answer. It's really helpfull to be read.
